dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: Do you have any shoes like these?
dialogue.zh: 像这样的鞋子你们有吗？

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: What size?

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: Size five.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: What colour?

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: Black.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: We don't have any.

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: But my sister bought this pair last month.
dialogue.zh: 但是，我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: Did she buy them here?

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: No, she bought them in the U.S.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: We had some shoes like those a month ago,
dialogue.zh: 一个月前我们有这样的鞋，

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: but we don't have any now.

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: Can you get a pair for me, please?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: I'm afraid that I can't.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: They were in fashion last year and the year before last.
dialogue.zh: 这鞋在去年和前年时兴，

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: But they're not in fashion this year.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: These shoes are in fashion now.
dialogue.zh: 现在流行的是这种鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: Lady
dialogue.en: They look very uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 这种鞋子看上去很不舒适。

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: They are very uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.en: But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!
dialogue.zh: 可是女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋子！

drills.zh: 但是我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。
